scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:knowledge-web
scripts.build:knowledge-contracts: npm run build -w @commerce/contract-primitives && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-contracts
scripts.build:knowledge-client: npm run build:knowledge-contracts && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-client
scripts.build:knowledge-web: npm run build:knowledge-client && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-web
scripts.build:knowledge-server: npm run build:knowledge-contracts && npm run build:knowledge-core && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-application && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-service-adapter && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-api && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-worker
scripts.build:knowledge-adapters: npm run build:knowledge-client && npm run build -w @commerce/knowledge-document-adapter
scripts.build:knowledge-foundation: npm run build:knowledge-client && npm run build:knowledge-server && npm run build:knowledge-adapters
